The fifth edition of the Henrietta Ovuede Table Tennis Competition for staff of Chrisland Schools Limited will hold on Friday, December 11, 2026. The competition is organised in partnership with Chrisland Schools Limited and was founded by Mrs Henrietta Ovuede. Over the years, it has served as a platform for staff engagement, healthy competition, physical wellness and camaraderie. It also promotes sporting excellence within the Chrisland community. This year’s edition will introduce a new feature with the proposed development of table tennis clubs within schools. The initiative is aimed at encouraging more students to take part in the sport, identifying emerging talents and creating more opportunities for young people to develop their abilities. Apart from the main staff competition, the event will feature novelty matches involving students. She added that it would also strengthen the culture of sports participation, discipline, teamwork and healthy competition in schools. Staff, students, school representatives and sports enthusiasts are expected to attend the event. The Henrietta Ovuede Table Tennis Competition is an annual sporting initiative which provides a platform for staff participation and sporting engagement. It also promotes table tennis within the school community.
